# CANDIDATE: TEST_STOP_MODIFICATION

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup uses a chart stop of rejected level + $0.50 buffer. We hypothesize that reducing this buffer to $0.25 will allow the engine to stay in trades longer during minor retracements, increasing edge capture on J's winner days without significantly increasing losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains identical to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence). Exit logic changes: chart stop triggers when SPY closes a 3-min candle above the rejected level + $0.25 buffer (instead of $0.50). All other exits (chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop) remain unchanged.
